evidence: The menu's only item joins the selected session (FrontendNetwork_JoinNamedSession) with the password typed on it; the session browser opens it for sessions that need a password.
Draws "Network | Enter Password", "Password Required For This Session" (0x1e8) and "Session Password: %s" (0x1c3) with g_unk0x00818da8.
Enter callback of the join password menu: clears the character queue and the typed password.
Appends typed characters to (Backspace deletes from) the password that Network_JoinEnumeratedSession is given.
Returns the join password menu; the session browser moves to it when joining a session that needs a password.
Returns g_unk0x00818f14, the lobby's chat line: FrontendMenu_UpdateNetworkSessionSetup types into it and sends it with Enter (NetworkChat_SendLine); the lobby's draw prints it.
